record_scope_reconstruction: Portuguese farmer blockades affect two specified Spanish-access roads: Paymogo HU7400 bridge and Rosal N433–Ficalho N260. These are separate phases; no all-border closure inferred.

source_checks.finding: Government-subdelegation reporting names Paymogo bridge obstruction on Portuguese side affecting HU7400 and separate Rosal N433, with emergency exception.
GNR-sourced February3 report says Ficalho traffic resumed close to midnight Friday.
ANTRAM/GNR updates identify N260 two-way closure and continued Ficalho closure February2 evening.
Named Puente Internacional del Chanza / Rio Chança bridge west of Paymogo on Minas de Santo Domingo route; not town centroid.

Inspected EIA heritage site49 names Ficalho frontier buildings on IP8 with UTM653650/4203039 and653648/4203094. Datum/zone for these coordinates not established; other sections use other systems, so no conversion assumed.
